svg.aria-label: UHW build phases as swimlanes. Planning runs on Claude models throughout. Rick runs Phase 0 and the pre-build items. A Claude Code session under AH4L in the builder's clone builds Phase 1, ports the convention kit and relocates the package into lupin. From gate G1.5 an AGY persona under the kernel builds Phases 2 and 3 on the test VM, writing lupin there. Phase 4, Gate G2 parity, the switch week, Gate G2 soak and the Delete run on the development server, with Rick running the week from the laptop console.
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: UHW: phases, places and who drives them (2026-11-18, after row 96)

g.text: C1 to C14; gate G1 passed

full table green on both families;
